page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew and Syriac headwords at the left of each entry; running head at top; a catchword-like Hebrew word at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: הרט הנלא Syr. Currere: Idem quod רהט, Impe-rat. הנלא ונשמא Curre post justitiam, id est, Sectare justitiam, 1.ad Tim.6.11. Sic in plurali, הנלאנו Sectamini dilectionem, 1. ad Cor.14.1. 1.ad Thess.5.15.
הרך הנלכן Syr. Hic: cum ל praefixo, הלכן Huc. Convenit Chald. הַלְכָא.
הרם הנסבן Syr. Aromata, Ἀρώματα, Marc.16.1. Lucæ 23.56.
הרמנא Chald. Licentia, Facultas, Potestas, Jobi 1.12. & 2. v.7.
הרס הנשמן Syr. Hæreticus, ad Tit.3.10.
הרפתקי Chald. Termini certi, statuti, solennitates, להרפתקי זמנא Ad solennitates temporis, Jobi 12.5. תשוון הרפתקי למלין Ponetis, statuetis terminos verbis, Jobi 18.2.
הרר Aphel הנסן Syr. Nocere, Molestum esse, Molestare, Molestiam exhibere, Lædere. Futur. ינסן Non nocebit eis, Marc.16.18. Cum affix. נסנכם Lædet vos, Lucæ 10.19. Vide & Lucæ 11.17. Act.18.10.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew characters in the entries are only approximately rendered here; vowel points and superlinear marks are simplified. Lower-right Hebrew word is a catchword.
